i.norm: Verifies that a {@link NodeIterator} filtered to a single node type can be used to mutate the elements it visits while the traversal is still in progress, without corrupting the iteration.
Two sibling divs, each containing two paragraphs, giving a small but nested tree to walk.

Walks the iterator to completion and asserts that the nodes it yields, encoded by {@link #describeNode}, match {@code expectedTrail}. Also checks the iterator never returns null and never returns the same node twice in a row.
Iterates every node under {@code el} and asserts the resulting trail matches {@code expectedTrail}.

Appends a short, human-readable description of {@code node} to {@code trail}, followed by ';'. Elements are shown as their tag name (plus "#id" when they carry an id), text nodes as their text, and anything else as its node name.
Iterate only Elements, appending "++" to the text of every element that has its own text.
The element-only traversal visits each element exactly once, in document order.
A fresh full traversal confirms the in-place text edits stuck on the underlying document.
